headline: Los Grobo unit Agrofina offers up to 70% debt haircut on $100M liabilities
summary: Agricultural chemical firm Agrofina, in preventive bankruptcy reorganization since 2025, presented debt proposals to 307 creditors offering options including a 70% haircut over three years or full repayment across eleven years.
why: Los Grobo is an iconic Argentine agribusiness conglomerate, and restructuring terms for its chemical arm illustrate the financial strain across the agricultural supply chain.

impacts.name: Agrofina
impacts.why: The proposed debt restructuring seeks significant debt relief to exit insolvency.
